connector.name: HPSILab Quant Finance
connector.registryDescription: Quant finance tools: stock analysis, options IV, Monte Carlo, AI prediction, risk scan, backtests.
connector.summary: Hosted at hpsilab.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package hpsilab-quant-finance-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the haiyunsky account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer hpsi_... API key. Optional: free-tier tools work anonymously (rate-limited demo mode).

env.name: HPSILAB_API_KEY
env.description: HPSILab API key (hpsi_...) from hpsilab.com settings
